scope: Ordinary-input earned simulation, not browser/human pacing proof. Both original endings earned independently. Explicit UI continuation/travel/respawn and validated earned save restore. No fact/pose/resource/enemy injection.

milestones.name: The Thorn Warden
lines: The Thorn Warden: I guarded tomorrow before your king put a price on it.
Aster: Watch its golden wind-up. Dash through the charge; jump over the ground-wave.
The first tree exhales. Somewhere, a seed begins to open.
Lyra: One heart remembers. Two are still sleeping. The eastern gate is open.

milestones.name: The Hour-Eater
lines: The Hour-Eater: Every second you steal will be paid in flame.
Aster: The cracks glow before it slams. Leap over the wave, then strike while it cools.
The furnaces dim. Not from cold—from finally having enough.
A clock strikes once, then twice. Lyra’s letter grows warm.

milestones.name: Veyr, the Hollow Regent
lines: Veyr: I took tomorrow so no one would have to say goodbye.
Lyra: You took every hello that had not happened yet.
Aster: When the crown lifts, falling light marks the ground. Move away, then return to strike.
The Dawnheart breaks its silence. Three stolen futures become one rising sun.
Veyr kneels beside the broken crown. Your letter now has room for a final line.

milestones.name: The Archivist Engine
lines: The Archivist Engine still counts futures under the old royal order.
Aster: Both light lanes are marked before they fire. Leave the marks, then strike while the Engine cools.
The last counters fall silent. No fourth world-heart waits inside this machine—only hours that were never its own.
Lyra: The old ending is ours. This is what we do after it. Take the eastern desk to release the archived hours.
